preconditions.description: Both inputs `a` and `b` must be strings.

postconditions.expression: all(c in a or c in b for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every character in the output must appear in at least one of the input strings `a` or `b`.

postconditions.expression: all(c not in b for c in return_value if c in a) and all(c not in a for c in return_value if c in b)
postconditions.description: The output consists of characters from `a` that are not in `b`, followed by characters from `b` that are not in `a`.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for c in a if c not in b) + sum(1 for c in b if c not in a)
postconditions.description: The length of the output is the sum of characters in `a` not present in `b` and characters in `b` not present in `a`.
